changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_enrollment ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, academy_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.customer(id), student_id BIGINT NOT NULL, batch_id BIGINT NOT NULL, start_date DATE NOT NULL, end_date DATE, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE','ENDED')), created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_by VARCHAR(100), updated_by VARCHAR(100), CHECK(end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= start_date), FOREIGN KEY(student_id, academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_student(id, academy_id), FOREIGN KEY(batch_id, academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.training_batch(id, academy_id), UNIQUE(id,academy_id) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX academy_enrollment_active_unique ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_enrollment(academy_id, student_id, batch_id) WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'; CREATE INDEX academy_enrollment_batch_scope ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.academy_enrollment(academy_id, batch_id, status); CREATE TABLE ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.training_session ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, academy_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.customer(id), batch_id BIGINT NOT NULL, session_date DATE NOT NULL, start_time TIME NOT NULL, end_time TIME NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SCHEDULED' CHECK(status IN ('SCHEDULED','CANCELLED','COMPLETED')), created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_by VARCHAR(100), updated_by VARCHAR(100), UNIQUE(academy_id,batch_id,session_date,start_time), UNIQUE(id,academy_id), FOREIGN KEY(batch_id,academy_id) REFERENCES ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.training_batch(id,academy_id), CHECK(end_time > start_time) ); CREATE INDEX training_session_schedule ON ${ARENA_DB_SCHEMA}.training_session(academy_id,session_date,status,batch_id);
